VarQCLease.dc.html: Know your lease rights in Québec
A landlord in Québec can't ask for a security deposit. Only the first month's rent can be asked in advance.
The lease must be on the official TAL form (« bail »). A homemade lease isn't allowed.
Check section G: the lowest rent paid in the last 12 months.
If the gap is too big, the information is false or blank, you can ask the TAL to lower your rent.
Get the building rules (« règlement de l'immeuble ») before you sign.
